post.description: Observe bookable SevenRooms slots for one local service date and party size. Excludes request-only placeholders. Optional exact local time filter. Not a reservation or hold; no restaurant-wide sold-out claim.

time.description: Optional exact displayed local HH:MM filter, applied to returned day slots. Pattern: ^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$.

venue.description: Known SevenRooms venue URL key, e.g. bennelong. No global name search. Pattern: ^[a-z0-9_-]{1,100}$.
